body:
Found when the three repos were run together on the integration candidate (docs/audits/2026-10-11-integration-head-candidate). Neither problem shows in a single repo's suite.

- Registers INVALID_LIMITS, BUDGET_SPENT and NO_BUDGET in ERROR_CODES. proof-agents#19 and proof-web#18 raise them.
- The contract test's scanner now treats a dict that spreads another dict (`{**answer, "code": CODE}`, as in proof-agents#17's RELEASE_FAILED) as a refusal, not a notice. Adds a planted test case for it.

tests/test_cli_contract.py: 33 passed.

commits.messageBody:
zeqome/proof-agents#17 answers a failed release as `{**answer, "code": "RELEASE_FAILED"}`: the answer it spreads is a
refusal, its `error` carried over. The scan read the dict as a notice (no literal `error`) and asked RELEASE_FAILED to
be a notice code. A dict that spreads another is now read as a refusal; a planted case covers it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.messageHeadline: test: the error-code scan reads a relabelled answer as a refusal

title: fix: register the Pursue limit codes; the error-code scan reads a relabelled answer as a refusal
